title: THE MNRAS RESULTS-SECTION SKELETON -- the paper's results structure assembled from the closed lanes: section by section, the headline numbers with lane citations, the falsifiers, the pending observations (DR4, tSZ, z~2.5, XRISM), the open-items box, and the three verdicts.

4.1_EQUIPARTITION_LAW.paper_sentence: One zero-parameter law across 12 decades: M_dark(<r)/M_b = r/r_M = sqrt(a0/g_N), rho = sqrt(G M_b a0)/(4 pi G r^2), sigma^2 = v_flat^2/2 = kappa = c_s^2 = 1/2, Sigma_ph(<r_M) = a0/(pi G).
headline_numbers: THE 12-DECADE LINE: pooled OLS slope b = 1.004 +- 0.011 on n = 542 objects over log M_b = 2.63-14.35; rms about identity 0.180 dex; the 2.89-dex gap reduced to 0.63 dex (78% filled) [G131/G162]
THE dSph FLOOR: median |log10(pred/obs)| = 0.222 over 34 dSphs (bright 0.163; classical 7-dwarf floor -0.00 inside +-0.35 dex) [G070/G03G]

THE DEEP END: HI dwarfs n = 55 rms 0.150 dex mass-independent (slope -0.00); SPARC 641 rings 0.145 dex zero parameters; the GC floor crossing M_cross = 1.23e5 M_sun at r_M/r_h = eta/2 = 3.39 EXACTLY (eta = 7.0 +- 1.2) [G114/G071/G074]

THE UNIVERSAL SURFACE DENSITY: Sigma_ph(<r_M) = a0/(pi G) = 213.74 M_sun/pc^2 machine-precision over six decades (M_b cancels; alt 257.52); local rho_dark(R0) = 0.0081 M_sun/pc^3 in 0.008-0.015; column 17.7 M_sun/pc^2 in 15-25 [G078/G076]

THE AMPLITUDE: M_ph(<r_M) = M_b exactly (|ratio-1| = 2.2e-16, Lean-certified G090 rung 1); a0_eff = 1.08-1.10e-10 deep end 2.18-2.46 sigma (stat) above a0_DE = 9.3619e-11 (staircase collapsed from 5.2 sigma, G167/G193); MIGHTEE lane reading 1.8433e-10 = s_Lambda = 2 a0_DE = 1.87238e-10 at 0.12 sigma; one surviving parameter a0_eff with the registered decision tree [G090/G03E/G167/G189/G193/G190]
falsifiers: UFD departure: obs sigma ~2.5x pred, residual slope +0.16 +- 0.02 per dex (G070 V2-FAIL carried honestly)
z~2.5 BTFR zero point drifting +0.33-dex class -> amplitude not M_b-scaled at high z [G080]

the sliver (log M 13.07-13.70) is a DATA gap, stated not claimed [G162]

DR4 Dec 2 2026: 9 pre-registered rows scored (9/9 on mocks): RIDGE band [1.047,1.11], R-RIDGE +18.4% at 30.7 sigma, R-BREAK 7.43 kAU, DOUBLE-MAP D1 4.2x at 6.2 sigma / D2 27.8 vs 6.6 / D3 negative outer bin 5.6-sigma, FUNNEL F1a 34.7/140.6/1357 pc, F1b e^{+R/3} flare [G165]

4.2_ONE_BOUNDARY.paper_sentence: The theory has exactly one physical radius, the baryonic a0-crossing r_M = sqrt(G M_b/a0); the crossing is a first-order phase switch between the strong-field dust phase and the deep-field phantom phase; every phase mark sits on the projected line r_b = r_M sqrt(a0/g_ext); the RAR is that boundary's phase diagram.
headline_numbers: THE BREAK: MW rotation-curve break 6.13 kpc = 0.623 r_M (full kernel, G119/G149; EFE-cap 6.50-6.74 kpc = 0.66 r_M); identity r_efe/r_M = sqrt(a0/g_ext) to 1e-16

THE SEAM: r_t = 387 kpc = 0.96 x median r_M (402 kpc) [band 269-543 kpc]; p1 = 1.50 +- 0.04 -> p2 = 2.94 +- 0.04; d_BIC = -351 vs single index; the cluster environment sits at the a0 floor (g_ext = 1.08 a0) [G176]

THE JUMP: A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3 = 0.650 DERIVED from the collisionless infall (sigma_d = v_ff/sqrt(3) = 140.2 km/s) vs measured 0.484 (1.34x within 2); R = 1.09, 12/12 inside the derived band [0.125, 0.5]; A_integral = 0.364 agrees with A = 0.273 within 1.34x; the jump pins c0 [G182/G185/G186/G159]

THE PHASE DIAGRAM: inside r_M free dust carries the deficit (cluster dust 81.6% of M_dyn at 50 kpc = 97.6% of the missing mass; g_tot(R500)/a0 = 0.554 < 1 on 12/12); outside the phantom equilibrates (56.9% at R500); M_sat = 3.09e14 M_sun -- phantom above / all-dust below (f_dust = 0.919 = 1 - f_b, f_b = 0.081); boundary inside the 0.30-dex data gap (IC1633 1.73e14 -> A1644 3.48e14) [G140/G178/G179/G188]

THE FIRST-ORDER CHARACTER: dS = 10.8-23.7 k_B/particle, L/(N k_B T) = 10.8-23.7 (water-class 13.1), T_b = 9.52 K = the CMB at z = 2.49; temperature pivot 2/3 (T_obs/T_pred = 2 (M_dyn/M_b)(r_M/r)); pie pivot u = r_M/R500 [G132/G095/G188]
falsifiers: smooth steepening within d_BIC = 16 -- the sharp seam is provisional; report 'a resolved transition' until the BIC gap widens [G176]

4.3_CLUSTER_SECTOR.paper_sentence: M_dyn(<r) = M_b + M_ph + M_dust in closed form, with the phantom derived (Gauss-map charge), the dust a measured two-parameter law, the amplitude pinned by the derived infall jump; the sector's remaining freedom is the single number q.
headline_numbers: THE CLOSED FORM: M_ph = M_b(r)(r/r_M) (surface integral (1/4 pi G) oint g.dA; J^mu = 0 static, charge ASSIGNED G154/G180); dust c_dust = 0.72 (M500/8e14)^(-0.414 +- 0.157) (r/R500)^(-0.990 +- 0.035) [c0 = -0.145, q = -0.414, p = +0.990; rms 0.119 -> 0.097 dex; 38 systems M500 ~ 1e13-9e14]; closure SUM/M500 = 1 exactly [G192/G143/G179]

THE POWER LAW AND ITS FREEDOM: c0's combination PINNED by the derived jump (R = 1.09, 12/12); the last freedom is the single number q (measured -0.414 +- 0.157, q_jump = -0.34 +- 0.27 consistent); group-scale rise +0.536 +- 0.069 vs cluster +0.235 (2.3x steeper, 20/26 above, t = 4.3) [G143/G185/G140]

THE PIE: at R500 baryons 17.7% (15.1-21.5) / phantom 56.9% (54.0-60.7) / dust 24.6% (18.1-31.3); law pie closes to -0.18 +- 0.06 dex (window statement); dust 81.6% at 50 kpc; cosmic <s_d> = 0.805, <s_ph> = 0.111 [G179/G188/G187]

THE TEMPERATURE LAW: log10(T_obs/T_pred) = (2/3) log10 f + log10(2 r_M/R500), alpha = 2/3; 31-system rms 0.076 dex (clusters 0.067 = HSE scatter); closed form 3.51 vs measured 3.57; T_pie = T_vir at 0.057 dex; virial 1/2 excluded at ~2.2 sigma [G095/G135]

THE OUTER SLOPE: r^-2.404 +- 0.078 over [R500, 2R500], three instruments consistent (chi2 = 2.29/2, p = 0.32): X-ray dark residual -2.17 +- 0.32, gas beta-tail -2.624 +- 0.176, tSZ joint -2.37 +- 0.09; 7.7 sigma from NFW's -3, inside the theory band [-2.4, -2.0] [G184]
falsifiers: any system below 3.48e14 with f_dust(missing) < 0.85 voids the all-dust phase [G178]
the tSZ 3-way slope over [R500, 2R500]: (-2.94, -2.14) JOINT (center -2.54 +- 0.4) / phantom-only -1.44-class / steeper neither; 47.8 sigma pooled shape-only [G177]
inside-R500 degeneracy: knee at r_b/rs = 0.54 coincides with NFW's own transition -- only the outer slope discriminates (tSZ pooled error 0.09 resolves -2.4 vs -3 at ~7 sigma) [G160/G129]
constancy: f_ph must NOT trend with the disturbance flags [G194]

4.4_DARK_SECTOR.paper_sentence: One charge, two acceleration-selected phases; inverting the freeze temperature against the CMB dates the equilibrium's formation to cosmic noon and predicts the carrier mass m = 5.0-5.2 keV; the sector's cosmic bookkeeping closes Omega_dm to 1.000; the ontology is pre-registered as a charge-vs-relic test.
headline_numbers: THE PARTICLE MASS: m = [5.00, 5.19] keV (canonical, z* = 2.37-2.49; union over footings [4.55, 5.19] keV); m(z* = 2.4) = 5.05 keV; dm/dz* = 1.49 keV per unit z; T_b = 9.5 K = CMB at cosmic noon; KILL BAND m < 4 or m > 6 keV [G168/G132]

THE INDEPENDENT WINDOW: forest m >= 3.3-5.7 keV (Viel 3.3, Irsic 5.3, Villasenor 5.7, streaming 4.7) -- no framework input; loop z*->m->z* self-consistent ~10-20% (5.7 keV -> z* = 2.84); cluster-class converse decouples at z = 155-265 (dark ages): the MW-class sigma 119.2 km/s is the only equilibrium surviving both directions [G093/G168]

THE DENSITY-CLOSED COSMOLOGY: Omega_dust(envelope-inclusive) = 0.2619 = 99.2% of Omega_dm = 0.264 (within-R500 33.3% + envelope/ambient 65.9%); equilibrium 0.79-1.28%; eq + dust = 0.2640 = 1.000 of Omega_dm DENSITY-CLOSED; halo-integral keeps G115's warm-floor gap 0.60-0.79 (reservoir 2.0-6.2x, feed 8.28e12 M_sun/Gyr); Omega_Lambda = 0.6857 = +0.07% of Planck from a0 alone [G198/G187/G079/G115/G052]

THE ONTOLOGY ASSIGNED: the dark mass is the GAUSS-MAP CHARGE M_ph = (1/4 pi G) oint g.dA (G180 amendment; old Noether wording empty on the static branch, J^mu = 0, G154); a field configuration not a particle -- 40 years of null direct detections ARE the prediction; the equilibrium clears Tremaine-Gunn (m > 23.25 eV needed, 4.01x BELOW the killed relic window); free dust coldest species (v_therm < 0.055 km/s, lambda_fs < 0.5-0.8 Mpc vs the registered 0.6 Mpc) [G180/G154/G028/G084/G093]

THE DARK-AGES FREEZE: galaxy phantom froze at z* = 2.37-2.49 (T_b = 9.2-9.5 K); cluster-class at z = 155-265 (232-635 K; z*(841 km/s, 5 keV) = 166.5 reproduced); the constancy test passes 3/3 (f_ph flat across disturbed/relaxed, n = 12, MW p = 0.39/0.59/0.49, Spearman rho = -0.203/-0.175, split < 20% variance; ZW1215 0.66 sigma from the median) [G194]
falsifiers: direct detection of a particle (there is no species) or LIGO/EHT non-GR signatures [G093/H027]
m outside [4.6, 5.2] keV from forest/sterile searches kills the cosmic-noon coincidence (the forward band is the commitment) [G168]
a BTFR zero-point break NOT in [2.37, 2.5] falsifies z_break = z* [G168/G011]

4.5_FORCE_FACE.paper_sentence: The theory modifies no force in any regime: the metric sector is exactly Einstein-Hilbert, so PPN = GR at the tested level; the scalar is a sector generator only, and the Solar-System prediction -- no phantom, no quadrupole, the Cassini null -- is architectural, not fitted.
headline_numbers: c_T = c IDENTICALLY: the scalar enters only via K = -(1/2)(dphi)^2/Lambda^4 (no derivative coupling, no disformal term); tensor quadratic action exactly Einstein-Hilbert; PPN(gamma, beta) = GR with nothing to arrange; GW170817 satisfied structurally [H027 T1 / G120]

THE CASSINI NULL -- PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED: the Solar-System sector is absent (local cloud unbound, EFE-capped at 7.4 kAU -- no l = 2 moment); every force-law completion fails the Park 2026 ceiling: bare mu2 kernel 6.44x/7.63x (both footings, S0-calibrated), 44-solve scan never below 6.18x (xi = 0 best); smooth-shell lemma (isotropic local screens preserve the l = 2 moment) closes the class with proof [G03_SPEC S3 / L243 / G120]
NO FIFTH FORCE ANYWHERE: MOND-looking dynamics is the gravity of the equilibrated charge dust (the RAR is the EOS, hydrostatics); the scalar itself never pulls [G031/G120]
LENSING = GR WITH REAL MASS: the phantom is real mass in Einstein's equation -- no conformal slip, no lensing-dead scalar (L241 kills conformal-only force laws, not this) [G03E V4]

NO SCALAR HAIR: the sourced equation div[f'(K) grad phi] = 4 pi G rho has no integration constant independent of the metric mass; EHT/LIGO see GR; compact objects carry M_ph/M = r/r_M (10 M_sun: 0.12 pc; 1e9 M_sun: 1.2 kpc) [H027 T2/T3 / G120]
falsifiers: a non-GR ringdown or shadow deviation (EHT/LIGO) -- no scalar hair permits none
a fifth-force signal at any scale
a lensing slip (light not seeing the full real mass)

V1_skeleton_complete.statement: Every one of the five results sections carries its 5 headline numbers with errors, units, and lane citations; the open-items box names all four open items with their tests; every pending instrument is mapped to the sections it decides (DR4 -> 4.1/4.2/4.5, tSZ -> 4.3, z~2.5 -> 4.1/4.4, XRISM -> 4.3). Nothing in the skeleton exceeds the committed lanes.

V2_falsifier_coverage.statement: Per-section falsifier counts: 4.1 four + one stated data gap; 4.2 five; 4.3 five; 4.4 five; 4.5 four. Every section has a named kill condition with the number that fires it; the asymmetric tSZ falsifiers and the m/z* circularity guard are stated as such.

V3_honest_statement.statement: The paper's results structure is ready to draft: 4.1 one zero-parameter law across 12 decades (b = 1.004 +- 0.011, n = 542) with the universal surface density and the dSph floor; 4.2 the single radius r_M marked at every scale (break 0.62, seam 0.96, jump 0.650, first-order latent heat, phase diagram); 4.3 the cluster closed form M_dyn = M_b + M_ph + M_dust with the derived amplitude, the 17.7/56.9/24.6 pie, the 2/3 temperature law, the -2.404 +- 0.078 outer slope at 7.7 sigma from NFW; 4.4 the dark sector with m = 5.0-5.2 keV, the density-closed 0.2619 = 99.2% of Omega_dm (sum = 1.000), and the pre-registered charge/relic ontology; 4.5 PPN = GR with the architectural Cassini null; 4.6 the open box (q, the sliver, the gap, the four pending verdicts). The results TEXT (prose + figures) remains to be written from this skeleton; no new calculation is required.
